title: psychotria guadalupensis subsp. grosourdieana
intro: Psychotria guadalupensis subsp. grosourdieana, commonly known as Grosourdy's Psychotria, is a plant species of the Rubiaceae family, native to Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Grosourdy's Psychotria include potential uses as an anti-anxiety agent, anticonvulsant, and anti-inflammatory, with its bioactive constituents believed to include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, although more research is necessary to fully understand its effects. Further study is required to confirm the specific bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
